description: 220pF 50V C0G ±5% 0805 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
compatibility_notes: Third code on the existing generic 0805 220 pF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C107145 (Yageo CC0805KRX7R9BB221, X7R +/-10% 50 V) and the exact-maker FH X7R variant C1727 (0805B221K500NT) already exists. C1805 is the exact FH C0G +/-5% SKU (0805CG221J500NT, 50 V), so it gets its own maker/mpn variant ID linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established variant taxonomy. Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 220 pF value, package and 50 V rating, but C0G +/-5% is the more stable, tighter-tolerance dielectric than either X7R choice; projects needing C0G stability at 220 pF/0805 should pick this variant explicitly and neither X7R choice is downgraded. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 3,293 recorded as observed. Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
